measurement_boundary: Loading the selected checkpoint, the test TSV and cached image features, tokenisation with the checkpoint's training vocabulary, test-set prediction, metric calculation and saving predictions; excludes training (see evaluated_experiment_id). CodeCarbon machine mode measures the whole computer, so the idle desktop, display output and any other open programs are included; see the idle-baseline run for this fixed background draw.
reuse_notes: Reuses the selected checkpoint of the linked training run and cached image features.
notes: Test evaluation after the median-validation selection was recorded.
carbon_intensity_source: NESO Carbon Intensity API (api.carbonintensity.org.uk/intensity/stats), Great Britain national half-hourly actual intensity; mean of monthly averages Nov 2025 to Oct 2026 weighted by days = 121.7, rounded to 122 gCO2/kWh. National 12-month average, NOT time-specific or regional. NESO reports direct generation CO2, not life-cycle CO2e, and excludes transmission/distribution losses; this is covered by the upper bound.
carbon_intensity_range_source: Low: lowest NESO monthly national average in the same 12 months (Apr 2026, 94 g/kWh). High: CodeCarbon 3.3.2 bundled UK (GBR) annual intensity for 2023 (237.589 g/kWh, global_energy_mix.json), a higher mix-based estimate that brackets the CO2 vs CO2e and older-grid-mix methodology differences.
pue_source: Personal desktop, no data-centre cooling or facility overhead; PUE fixed at 1.0.
uncertainty_basis: Each component's energy is multiplied by a low/high factor chosen by how it was obtained. GPU (NVIDIA NVML board energy counter) +/-5%. CPU from the RAPL package energy counter +/-10% (AMD RAPL is the processor's own model, not a wall-socket meter). CPU estimated from load x TDP if RAPL is unreadable 0.5x to 2x. RAM is always a CodeCarbon heuristic (5 W per guessed DIMM; 4 DIMMs = 20 W for 30.5 GB) and two DDR5 modules can draw about 5 W, so 0.25x to 1x. The total is then multiplied by 1.0 to 1.25 for unmetered motherboard, storage, fans and PSU conversion loss. Emissions bounds combine the energy bounds with the carbon-intensity range. These are stated engineering assumptions, not statistical confidence intervals.
measurement_exclusions: Monitor, network equipment, room lighting, embodied/manufacturing carbon, dataset download and centrally prepared resources. Wall-socket losses are not metered; they are covered only by the uncertainty upper bound.
